title: Was passiert wirklich mit deinen 100 € im ETF?

visuals.scriptBeat: 100 Euro verlassen das Verrechnungskonto, aber nicht direkt Richtung hundert Unternehmen.
visuals.expectedVisual: A premium stylized desk scene with a generic broker purchase confirmation showing only the short German label “100 €”, one clearly visible ETF share document in the foreground, and many different real-world company environments far behind it, separated so the viewer immediately sees that one fund share sits between the money and the companies.
visuals.animationIntent: Reveal the hidden ETF-share layer between the investor payment and underlying companies.
visualBeats: companies appear behind the fund layer

visuals.scriptBeat: Der Broker leitet den Auftrag an einen Handelsplatz; du kaufst einen Fondsanteil.
visuals.animationIntent: Show a concrete buy order becoming a matched ETF trade.

visuals.scriptBeat: Du kaufst einen Anteil am Fonds, nicht gleichzeitig jede einzelne Aktie in deinem eigenen Namen.
visuals.googleFlowFileName: YouTube Bild 03 - ETF Anteil statt Einzelaktien.png
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D investment desk: one large paper certificate labeled “ETF-Anteil” sits in the investor area. Behind a clear divider is the fund portfolio containing many small but recognizable company share documents. Do not show the investor directly holding each company share. Make the ownership layer unmistakable.

visuals.scriptBeat: Market Maker und Authorized Participant verbinden den Börsenhandel mit dem Fondsportfolio.
visuals.animationIntent: Explain secondary market versus primary market and the basket-for-shares exchange.
visualBeats: basket and ETF units exchange with fund

visuals.scriptBeat: Creation/Redemption hilft, den Börsenpreis nahe am Wert des Fondsportfolios zu halten.
visuals.animationIntent: Show a temporary ETF market-price gap narrowing toward portfolio value.

visuals.scriptBeat: Der Index ist das Regelwerk; der ETF versucht seine Wertentwicklung nachzubilden.
visuals.googleFlowFileName: YouTube Bild 06 - Index Regeln und Portfolio.png
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal 16:9 stylized 3D finance worktable with a printed rulebook labeled “Indexregeln” on the left and a real portfolio tray labeled “ETF-Portfolio” on the right. The rulebook contains simple weighted rows for generic sectors, and the portfolio tray visibly mirrors those weights with real share documents. No dashboard UI.
visuals.animationIntent: Animate index weights from the rulebook onto the matching portfolio holdings.

visuals.scriptBeat: Bei physischer Replikation hält der Fonds tatsächlich Wertpapiere aus dem Index.
visuals.animationIntent: Build a tangible 3D portfolio from weighted securities that represent the index.

visuals.scriptBeat: Bei sehr breiten Indizes kann Sampling eine repräsentative Auswahl statt jeder Position nutzen.
visuals.animationIntent: Show many index constituents narrowing to a representative sample while preserving category proportions.

visuals.scriptBeat: Die Fondsgesellschaft verwaltet das Portfolio; eine Verwahrstelle hält das Fondsvermögen getrennt.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D institutional scene with two clearly separate functions: a fund management desk labeled “Fondsgesellschaft” reviewing the ETF rulebook, and a secure custody area labeled “Verwahrstelle” physically holding the portfolio documents. The two areas are connected operationally but their assets are visibly separated.

visuals.scriptBeat: Fondsvermögen ist vom Vermögen der Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaft getrennt.
visuals.animationIntent: Make legal asset separation tangible without implying protection from market losses.
visualBeats: fund assets remain in separate custody

visuals.scriptBeat: Ein breit gestreuter Aktien-ETF kann viele Unternehmen aus Ländern und Branchen bündeln.
visuals.expectedVisual: A cinematic stylized 3D global business landscape on one continuous dark background: generic technology campus, factory, healthcare facility, consumer goods warehouse and bank from different regions, all visibly connected back to one foreground object labeled “Breiter Aktien-ETF”. Keep every business recognizable and avoid logo copies.
visuals.animationIntent: Travel from one ETF share through different real-economy sectors to reveal diversification.

visuals.scriptBeat: Breite Streuung reduziert Einzelwertrisiko, beseitigt aber nicht das Marktrisiko.
visuals.animationIntent: Contrast single-stock concentration with diversified holdings and then demonstrate common market risk.
visualBeats: broad market shock affects the group

visuals.scriptBeat: Ein Themen-ETF kann stark konzentriert sein, obwohl ETF auf dem Etikett steht.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D portfolio basket labeled “Themen-ETF” filled mostly with similar semiconductor and AI-related company documents from one narrow industry cluster. Beside it, a second smaller reference basket labeled “Breiter ETF” contains clearly different sectors. The narrow basket must visibly lack variety.

visuals.scriptBeat: Dividenden der Unternehmen fließen in das Fondsvermögen.
visuals.animationIntent: Route dividends from multiple companies into the ETF fund pool before any investor-level decision.

visuals.scriptBeat: Ausschüttend zahlt aus; thesaurierend legt im Fonds wieder an.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal side-by-side stylized 3D fund administration scene. Left folder labeled “Ausschüttend”: dividend cash moves from the ETF fund toward an investor payout envelope. Right folder labeled “Thesaurierend”: dividend cash stays inside the fund and is placed back into portfolio securities. Keep both paths concrete and equally large.
visuals.animationIntent: Animate the same dividend entering two alternative ETF income paths.

visuals.scriptBeat: Orderkosten, Spread und laufende Fondskosten sind unterschiedliche Kostenebenen.
visuals.animationIntent: Separate transaction, market and fund-level costs so viewers do not confuse them.
visualBeats: annual fund cost separated from transaction costs

visuals.scriptBeat: Der Spread ist die Differenz zwischen Kauf- und Verkaufspreis.
visuals.animationIntent: Make bid and ask prices converge visually while preserving the gap called Spread.

visuals.scriptBeat: Kosten stehen in Produkt- und Brokerinformationen und sollten vor dem Kauf geprüft werden.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D desk with three real paper documents: one broker price sheet labeled “Orderkosten”, one exchange trade note labeled “Spread”, and one ETF product information sheet labeled “Laufende Kosten”. A simple magnifying glass inspects the three fields. No app UI and no generic floating cards.

visuals.scriptBeat: Der ETF-Kurs folgt wirtschaftlich den Marktwerten der zugrunde liegenden Vermögenswerte.
visuals.animationIntent: Show several holdings moving differently and their weighted combined effect on one ETF value.

visuals.scriptBeat: Ein hypothetischer Verlust von 20 Prozent macht aus 100 Euro 80 Euro.
visuals.animationIntent: Turn a 20% market drawdown into a concrete 100-to-80-euro example.

visuals.scriptBeat: Breite Aktienmärkte können schwanken; ein langer Anlagehorizont bedeutet nicht, dass Verluste unmöglich sind.
visuals.googleFlowFileName: YouTube Bild 21 - ETF Schwankungen ueber Zeit.png
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal cinematic long-term investing scene: a desk calendar path from “2026” through later unlabeled years, with one ETF portfolio document traveling through clearly visible market up-phases and down-phases. The final state should not imply guaranteed profit; end near a neutral evaluation point, not a giant upward arrow.
visuals.animationIntent: Move the ETF through alternating up and down market periods over a long calendar.
visualBeats: long horizon ends without guaranteed payoff

visuals.scriptBeat: Bei Broker-Insolvenz bleiben verwahrte Wertpapiere grundsätzlich herausverlangbar oder übertragbar.
visuals.animationIntent: Separate broker business failure from custody of customer securities and show transfer to another depot.
visualBeats: securities transfer to another custody account

visuals.scriptBeat: Das Fondsvermögen ist vom Vermögen der Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaft getrennt.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D fund structure scene: the office labeled “Fondsgesellschaft” is visibly closed, while a physically separate custody vault labeled “Fondsvermögen” remains intact with the portfolio documents inside. Do not use a shield metaphor and do not imply protection from falling market prices.

visuals.scriptBeat: 0,2 Prozent entsprechen bei 100 Euro ungefähr 20 Cent pro Jahr, wenn Kursänderungen ignoriert werden.
visuals.animationIntent: Translate a percentage fee into intuitive euro amounts at two portfolio sizes.

visuals.scriptBeat: Du besitzt ETF-Anteile; wirtschaftlich bist du am Fondsportfolio beteiligt, nicht direkt als Einzelaktionär jeder Firma eingetragen.
visuals.googleFlowFileName: YouTube Bild 25 - Was du wirklich besitzt.png
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal layered ownership scene. Foreground: one document labeled “Dein ETF-Anteil”. Middle layer: a transparent legal fund container labeled “Fondsvermögen”. Background: many real company share documents held inside that fund container. Keep the layers physically separated and readable.
visuals.animationIntent: Move the camera through investor ETF share, fund-asset layer and underlying securities.

visuals.scriptBeat: Ändert sich der Index, passt der ETF sein Portfolio nach den Regeln an.
visuals.animationIntent: Show index weights changing and the fund portfolio rebalancing to follow them.

visuals.scriptBeat: Vor dem Kauf: Index verstehen, Streuung prüfen, Kosten und Risiken des konkreten Fonds lesen.
visuals.expectedVisual: A literal stylized 3D review desk with three large physical documents arranged as a real checklist: “Index”, “Streuung”, and “Kosten & Risiken”. Each document contains one simple visual cue: index composition table, diverse sector list, and cost/risk section. A pen marks all three only after they are visibly inspected.

visuals.scriptBeat: Der komplette Weg: Kaufauftrag, ETF-Anteil, Börsenmechanismus, Fondsportfolio, Erträge, Kosten und Risiko.
visuals.animationIntent: Finish with one coherent camera journey through the full ETF system without introducing new facts.
